content: MCP server architecture: client-server model, one MCP client per server; servers expose Tools (executable actions), Resources (contextual data), Prompts (templates). Best practice is a thin MCP server that wraps existing REST API endpoints and translates tool calls into REST requests (e.g. GitHub MCP server pattern) rather than reimplementing business logic. Single responsibility per server. Auth: user auth vs AI-client authorization (OAuth2.1) are distinct; API-key auth via env var works for local/CLI MCP; log every tool invocation (tool, params, caller, session) for audit trail.
